resources.string: Permanently delete the actual audio file

Delete “%1$s” from this device?

File: %2$s

The actual audio file will be permanently deleted, not just removed from FT Music. It will also be removed from FT Music favorites, playlists, and listening history. This cannot be undone.
This file appears to have already been deleted. Remove its entry from FT Music? It will also be removed from favorites, playlists, and listening history.
The file has changed since the last scan. Scan your device again before deleting it.
FT Music cannot access this file. Check your audio permission and scan your device again.
The file could not be deleted. Nothing was removed from your FT Music library.
Android could not confirm whether the file was removed. Check Files and scan your device again.
Deletion cancelled. The file was not removed.
Storage permission was denied. The file was not removed.
Missing song removed from FT Music.
The file was deleted, but FT Music could not update its library. Scan your device again.
